title: Cocktails
description: Allows you to combine potions in a crafting table to create a potion cocktail!
body:
# Cocktails
# This mod has been integrated into my consolidated mod, crdtrd's mood! [Check it out!](https://modrinth.com/mod/crdtrdsmood)
This was done to make maintaining my mods easier. Versions for Minecraft 26.1.2+ are available there.
## Summary
A server side fabric mod that allows potions to be combined into one via crafting grid. That's really all there is to it.
## Features
- Combine potions! Preserves full effects.
- Splash potions override normal potions, and lingering potions override all potion types.
- Tasty and makes you feel good! Don't drink too much though.
## Requirements
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
